The absence of enhancement ('ET Volume (mL)': 0.0, 'Proportion Enhancing': 0.0) and necrosis ('Proportion Necrosis': 0.0) are classic imaging features of a lower-grade glioma (WHO grade 2 or 3). According to WHO CNS5 criteria, this entity is designated as WHO grade 4 by definition, regardless of histological or radiological features like enhancement. The molecular implication of the location is considered to be the overriding factor for grading.
